components.name: Button
components.description: Triggers an action. Use `primary` for the main action, `secondary` for alternatives, `ghost` for low-emphasis actions and `danger` for destructive ones.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button while an action runs. Sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. Use one `primary` per view area; `danger` for destructive actions.

notes: The label must describe the action. For icon-only buttons use IconButton.

parts.name: IconButton
parts.description: Square button with only an icon. Prefer Button with a visible label when space allows.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name in Finnish, e.g. "Poista asiakas".

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon, e.g. from the design system icon set. It is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button while an action runs. Sets `aria-busy`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. Use one `primary` per view area; `danger` for destructive actions.

notes: The `aria-label` prop is required and must be Finnish and action-oriented.

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text field with built-in label, hint and error message.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Setting it marks the control invalid and links the message to it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Helper text shown under the label and linked with `aria-describedby`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, in Finnish. Always shown above the control.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required and shows an asterisk. Explain the asterisk once per form.

notes: Label is required. Error text is linked via aria-describedby and the control gets aria-invalid.
